# Focus timer

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pomodoro/

Start a focused work session with a visible countdown. Choose a custom duration or switch between focus, short break and long break presets.

## How to use it

1. Choose or enter the content for this tool.
2. Start the action with the settings you want.
3. Review the result before copying, sharing or continuing.

## Example

Work on one task for 25 minutes, then reset the timer for a five-minute break.

## Limits and checks

Keep the tool open. Browsers can suspend background tabs, and a soft completion sound depends on browser audio support.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
